meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把测序数据变成信号图谱与质控报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常做 ChIP-seq/RNA-seq 测序分析,需要出质控图和信号图谱
copy.tagline_en: Turn sequencing data into signal tracks and quality-control reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you analyze ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data and need fast QC and plots

howto.what: 把 BAM 文件转成归一化的 bigWig 覆盖度轨道,做质控(相关性、PCA、指纹图),并在 TSS、peak 等位点画热图和曲线图,面向 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 数据。
howto.when: 当你提到「BAM 转 bigWig」「ChIP 质控」「TSS 热图」等关键词,或要求做 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq 等 NGS 分析时触发。

say.text: 把这些 BAM 转成 bigWig 覆盖度轨道,用 RPGC 归一化
say.note: 会生成 .bw 覆盖度文件

say.text: 帮我做 ChIP-seq 质控,看重复样本相关性
say.note: 输出相关性热图与指纹图

say.text: 在 TSS 附近画一张信号热图
say.note: 先算 matrix,再出热图 png

howto.what_en: Turns BAM alignments into normalized bigWig coverage tracks, runs QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints) and draws heatmaps/profiles around TSS and peaks for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert BAM to bigWig, run ChIP QC, plot TSS heatmaps, or analyze ChIP-seq, RNA-seq or ATAC-seq data.

say_en.text: Convert these BAM files to bigWig coverage tracks with RPGC normalization
Run ChIP-seq QC and check replicate correlation
Plot a signal heatmap around TSS
say_en.note: Builds the matrix, then the heatmap png
